digo_source: Mgombato ('mkilifi', 'mwarobaini neem tree'); ICRAF ('Digo: Muarubaini, Mwarobaini, Mkilifi')

teaser.en: Its name comes from the Swahili word for forty, after the forty diseases this bitter tree is said to cure.
teaser.sw: Jina lake linatokana na neno la Kiswahili la arobaini, kwa sababu ya magonjwa arobaini ambayo mti huu mchungu husemekana kuyatibu.

summary.en: *Mwarobaini* is the neem, a fast-growing evergreen tree with bitter leaves, planted in villages along the coast. It is known above all as a medicine for fevers and malaria, and also gives shade, poles, firewood and insecticide.
summary.sw: *Mwarobaini* ni mwarubaini, mti unaokua haraka usiopukutika wenye majani machungu, unaopandwa vijijini kando ya pwani. Unajulikana zaidi kama dawa ya homa na malaria, na pia hutoa kivuli, nguzo, kuni na dawa ya kuua wadudu.

about.en: *Mwarobaini* is a fast-growing evergreen tree with a dense, rounded crown. Its leaves are divided into many narrow, toothed, slightly curved leaflets, and they taste intensely bitter. Small, white, honey-scented flowers come in loose sprays, followed by small olive-like fruits that ripen yellow.
about.sw: *Mwarobaini* ni mti unaokua haraka usiopukutika, wenye taji nzito ya mviringo. Majani yake yamegawanyika katika vijani vingi vyembamba, vyenye meno pembezoni na vilivyopinda kidogo, na ladha yake ni chungu mno. Maua madogo meupe yenye harufu ya asali huota kwa mashada yaliyolegea, na hufuatwa na matunda madogo kama zeituni yanayoiva yakawa ya manjano.

where.en: It is planted in villages along the coast and has spread on its own. It is common around Vanga, in the far south of Kwale.
where.sw: Hupandwa vijijini kando ya pwani na umeenea wenyewe. Ni wa kawaida karibu na Vanga, kusini kabisa mwa Kwale.

uses.en: Neem is widely used in medicine for fevers and malaria, and is said to 'cure forty diseases'. It also gives shade, poles and firewood, and is used as an insecticide.
uses.sw: Mwarubaini hutumika sana kama dawa ya homa na malaria, na husemekana 'kutibu magonjwa arobaini'. Pia hutoa kivuli, nguzo na kuni, na hutumika kama dawa ya kuua wadudu.

culture.en: Its bitterness, *utsungu* in Digo, is one of the features people use to recognise it.
culture.sw: Uchungu wake, *utsungu* kwa Kidigo, ni mojawapo ya sifa ambazo watu hutumia kuutambua.

names.en: The Digo names are *mwarobaini*, *muarubaini* and *mkilifi*. Swahili calls it *mwarubaini*, and Mgombato also gives the Swahili *mkilifi* and *mzamba*. In Giriama it is *mkilifi*. In English it is neem or margosa. The name *mwarobaini* comes from *arobaini*, 'forty', for the forty diseases it is said to cure.
names.sw: Majina ya Kidigo ni *mwarobaini*, *muarubaini* na *mkilifi*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mwarubaini*, na Mgombato pia inatoa majina ya Kiswahili *mkilifi* na *mzamba*. Kwa Kigiriama huitwa *mkilifi*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *neem* au *margosa*. Jina *mwarobaini* linatokana na neno *arobaini* (40), kwa magonjwa arobaini ambayo husemekana kuyatibu.

conservation.en: Neem is an introduced tree that has naturalised on the coast.
conservation.sw: Mwarubaini ni mti wa kigeni ulioletwa ambao umejizoesha na kuenea wenyewe pwani.

reason.en: Another plant used against malaria and insects
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaotumika dhidi ya malaria na wadudu

reason.en: Another bitter plant used for malaria
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine mchungu unaotumika kwa malaria

mgombato: mkilifi (mi) neem tree (Azadirachta indica); mkilifi, mwarubaini, mzamba. (See: mwarobaini)
mwarobaini (mi) neem tree, margosa tree (Azadirachta indica); mwarubaini, mkilifi, mzamba. (See: mkilifi)
